# Accordion

## Block Markup

This is a **hybrid block**. It saves static markup that the server may enhance during rendering.

```html
<!-- wp:accordion {"iconPosition":"right","showIcon":true,"autoclose":false,"headingLevel":3} -->
<!-- Content... -->
<!-- /wp:accordion -->
```
